entries.bde76696d8e723f9: Since its founding in 1920, it has operated under the management philosophy of “providing people with dreams, enjoyment and emotion,” and its basic management policy is “to provide society with wholesome entertainment through the film business and to contribute to the development of film culture.” In its core film business, it aims to stabilize profitability over the medium to long term through screening appealing, high-quality films and operating with an eye on profitability and costs. It positions itself as a mini-theater that selects good and talked-about films regardless of production scale, and says it is also working to collaborate with the local trade area through events such as the Shinjuku Higashiguchi Film Festival and to broaden its base of film fans.
